messages:
Alice M: Quick heads-up — planning to push 1.14.2 with only the security patch + a tiny deps bump. Goal: minimal diff, fast rollback if needed. Cutoff 18:00 UTC today. Anyone hitting blockers?
Ben K: I have one outstanding review on the DB migration heatmap but it's non-blocking for this patch (that's in a different branch). Not blocking. :thumbsup:
Carla S: PR is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/pull/4123 — cherry-pick of CVE fix + bump serde to 1.2.4. CI failing on a flaky integ test right now, investigating.
Dan R: @Carla S which integ? I can take a look in 10m. If it's flaky we can ignore for the hotfix as long as unit tests pass and smoke is green.
Carla S: failing: tests/serving/kvcache_expiry_test.py — looks timing-sensitive (sleep). Reproduced locally once. I'm going to add a jitter hack and re-run.
Elena P: Changelog: we should add a single-line entry under 1.14.2: "security: patched CVE-2026-xxxx; updated serde to 1.2.4" — keep it terse. I'll take it if someone posts the final commit hash.
Ben K: Rollback plan: if the hotfix causes regressions, we revert the cherry-pick commit and cut a quick 1.14.3? Or do we prefer rolling back to 1.14.1 tag and re-deploy?
Alice M: Prefer reverting the cherry-pick + redeploy. That keeps semver tidy. Need an on-call to perform rollback steps. @Dan R willing?
Dan R: Yup, will standby. I'll also prepare a one-liner revert: `git revert -m 1 <cherry-pick-commit>` and a short smoke checklist.
Carla S: CI passed on second run, fixed the jitter. New commit: a3f4c9b. Tests: unit ok, integration flaky test now green.
Elena P: Adding changelog note with a3f4c9b. Also tagging release notes draft in #release-notes for legal review.
Alice M: Great. Can we get an ETA on branch cut and deploy job? Aim to cut branch at 17:30 UTC, smoke at 17:40, start deploy 17:50 to avoid peak traffic.
Carla S: Branch cut done: `git checkout -b release/1.14.2-lift a3f4c9b` at 17:31 UTC. Pushed.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: job_id=deploy-2105123456-01, target=staging, image=redwood/runtime:1.14.2-rc.
Dan R: Running smoke now against staging metrics. Checklist: health endpoints, 95th p95 < 200ms, kv cache hitrate unchanged, basic-generation sanity.
Ben K: I'm on logs and alert watch. I'll reroute any paged alerts to Dan for the next 30m.
Carla S: Staging smoke results: health ok, p95 ~ 180ms, kv cache hitrate nominal. One warning in logs about a deprecated flag, not related.
Alice M: Green to proceed. Start canary deploy at 17:50 UTC with 5% traffic, monitor 10m, then ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary started: canary_id=can-2105123456, percentage=5% — monitoring hooks active.
Elena P: Quick reminder for release metadata: include migration-free note and add SLO owner as `@Ben K` in the release ticket.
Dan R: Canary health after 10m: no errors, latency stable. Ramping to 50%.
Ben K: Watching alerts, none firing. Logs look clean.
Carla S: Pinging reviewers for post-merge approvals to mark the PR as released. @Alice M can you confirm merge once we hit 100%?
Alice M: Will confirm. If anything strange between now and 18:00 UTC we abort and revert. Otherwise I'll merge the cherry-pick branch and tag 1.14.2.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: success. release_tag=1.14.2, image=redwood/runtime:1.14.2
Alice M: Merged and tagged 1.14.2 at 17:59 UTC. Thanks all. Please file any regressions in #incidents and @Dan R will triage.
Ben K: Nice and clean. Quick changelog nudge to product: @Elena P posted. :tada:
Elena P: Noted, I'll publish release notes after legal ok.
Dan R: I'll stay on watch for 30m then hand-off to infra on-call. Thanks everyone.
Carla S: Thanks — whole thing stayed minimal as planned.
Alice M: Great teamwork, short and smooth. :rocket:
